intro:
Planning mate

There are four crosses on the board. Your job is to place the pieces which are under the board on the crosses so that Black is mated.
After placing the fourth piece you are not allowed to make any changes. But you can change things before that.

texts: Planning mate
Place the pieces on the crosses in such a way that Black is checkmated.
